narrative:
Putnam County has 23,595 registered voters, with 49.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 42.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 8.0%, a pronounced Republican lean of 34.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.6% of registrants. Registration is trending bluer in younger age cohorts (1990s–2000s births lean -25.7% D−R vs -37.0% for 1950s–60s cohorts).
